title: Nifty Idea
text:
Nifty Idea. UPDATE:

I DECIDED TO DEDUCT A STAR FOR THESE AFTER TRYING TO CLEAN ONE. IT IS NOT AN EASY PROCESS. ANY FOOD THAT COMES IN CONTACT WITH THE WAX IS STUCK FAIRLY WELL. iN COLD WATER THERE ISN'T MUCH TO DO TO CLEAN THEM. I CAN SEE A LOT OF ISSUES WITH FOOD CROSS CONTAMINATION USING THESE. THEY WILL WORK FOR HARD CHEESES, BUT I WON'T USE THEM FOR ANYTHING ELSE. NOT EVEN COVERING A BOWL.

Been wanting to try these for a long time. I opened the pack and wrangled loose the smallest sheet to wrap a piece of cheese in. This stuff is really sticky and stuck together. I tried to warm it a little I my hands to get it to be flexible as per the instructions. It conforms to whatever you are wrapping very well and it stays stuck closed. The downside is that you can't see through it, so if I wrap a bunch of cheese in these for instance, the only way to tell what's what is by the size or shape assuming I can remember which is what. Time will tell how well they hold up.

product_metadata.title: Reusable Beeswax Food Storage Wraps, SURDOCA® Assorted 3 Pack, Sustainable Plastic Free Waxed Cotton Cloth Wraps, Plastic Free Alternative to Food Storage(B)
features: Eco-friendly and 100% Recyclable Surdoca beeswax wrap is made of organic cotton, pure natural beeswax and tree resin. Our packaging is made from 100% recycled paper. Every ingredient we used comes from the earth and will return to the earth. If you are an environmentally friendly person who loves cooking, you will love it.

Keep Food Alive and fresh Beeswax has a natural waterproof function. Cotton will form a dense waterproof protective layer after batik. Wrap it with food to slow the loss of water while keeping food breathing and fresh food. At the same time, beeswax can keep food for a long time.

Versatile, Easy to Use Just wrap it around a piece of food or over a bowl or bottle, press the edge to cover it tightly. You can use your beeswax Wrap to wrap fruit, vegetables, bread, cheese, sandwich and we don't recommend wrap raw meat and hot food with it. you can easily make a food bag or sandwich bag within a few steps.

Reusable and Washable Hand wash in cold water with a neutral detergent and dry naturally. It can be reused more than 100 times under normal use. Each beeswax package can save you more than 100 plastic bags and reduce environmental damage.
description: Founded in the fall of 2017, SURDOCA is a young and caring home storage brand. We hope to provide you with a full range of home storage products with high quality and comfortable materials and excellent design. At present, we have opened up six countries in North America and Europe, and we hope to bring tidy and convenience to more families all over the world. We are always looking for more environmentally friendly materials and better storage solutions for our tens of thousands of family customers. This beeswax wrap is an excellent environmentally friendly alternative to plastics, 100% natural and 100% degradable. environmentally friendly and harmless, each beeswax wrap can be reused more than 100 times, which is equivalent to reducing the use of more than 100 plastic bags. Beeswax and organic cotton are renewable resources. We don't have to worry about resource depletion. ♦
Please wash with cold water and neutral detergent, air dry, avoid wringing or hot drying. ♦

1. It is recommended not to use beeswax cloth to wrap foods with high fat content such as raw meat and fat, because some beeswax may be dissolved by fat and reduce the service life. 2. A small amount of beeswax will stick to your hands during use. This is normal. As the number of uses increases, the waterproof performance of propolis will deteriorate. Please replace the new beeswax wrap or wax it in time. 3. Since beeswax is flammable and easy to soften at high temperatures, avoid placing it near heat sources such as microwave ovens and stoves and reducing sun exposure to increase service life. 4. The beeswax cloth will become hard at low temperatures. This is a normal condition and can be used only by warming by hand. ♦
